offering_description.value: Sells life insurance, residential mortgage loans, and cemetery and mortuary services to individuals and families in the United States. Policies are underwritten through insurance subsidiaries, and mortgages are originated through its own lending operations.

primary_products.value: life insurance policies; residential mortgage loans; cemetery plots and burial products

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; mortuary services; cemetery interment services; pre-need funeral planning

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals and families buying life insurance, home mortgages, and pre-need cemetery and funeral plans

end_markets.value: insurance; real estate finance; death care

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums from life policies and interest on mortgage loans; service fees: loan origination fees and mortuary and cemetery service fees; product sales: cemetery plots, caskets, and mortuary merchandise
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites life policies and originates mortgages for individual borrowers; asset operator: owns and runs cemeteries and mortuaries, selling interment and funeral services to families

geography_served.value: US national: life insurance and mortgages in many states, cemeteries and mortuaries in Utah, Texas, Arizona, Missouri

specialization.value: diversified: separate life insurance, mortgage lending, and cemetery and mortuary businesses

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: insurance agents selling life policies to individual customers; own locations: mortgage branch offices and loan officers serving home buyers; direct sales: cemetery and mortuary staff selling pre-need and at-need services to families
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensed by state insurance departments, mortgage lending licensed by states, cemeteries regulated by state cemetery boards

notes: Segment mix, ordering, and cemetery locations are from memory and may have changed; verify current details.
